title: Replace a failed monotonicity argument by a terminal path-sign witness
statement: The same complex continuation makes all allowed source-B jump rates negative. Bipartite parity fixes the sign of every trajectory ending in the chosen opposite color, and nonnegative controller weights cannot cancel it. Bounded stopped likelihoods extend holomorphically, contradicting a nondegenerate parameter-independent physical-interval terminal law.

requires: The exact source-B bipartite jump family and a hidden-parameter-independent common controller
Bounded physical stopping functional on every reference path, complete retained record and real boundary timing

assumptions: This is a menu-specific, ideal-boundary mathematical obstruction. Exact parameter access, new actuators, warranted baseline initialization/replacement and unbounded random hitting times remain allowed at their real costs. Endpoint-clock JOINT law must retain parameter dependence; the conditional endpoint-given-clock pattern need not itself vary. Retained controller state and reused seeds belong to the initial record or require independent future randomization. Decision latency must enter the actual kernel or be protected by an actual hold.
